premise: Xander is a teenage boy who is also a zombie. Becoming undead did not cancel school, family, chores, friends, embarrassment, or teenage problems.
rules: Xander is a person first and a zombie second.
Being undead creates complications but does not automatically solve ordinary teenage problems.
Family and friends can be funny without becoming disposable joke machines.
Do not contradict approved episodes unless the contradiction is deliberately explained in-story.
Cross-realm events may appear, but Xander does not initially understand the larger connected-world system.
established: Xander woke up dead on a Tuesday.
Tuesday is associated with pizza day.
Xander still worries about being grounded and doing chores.
An impossible wooded path exists near town.
The strange path can connect to the moss/Morri realm.
A chess-knight artifact can appear when the Morri chess event has been discovered.
recurring_jokes: Being dead does not excuse chores.
Adults remain concerned with normal rules during supernatural emergencies.
Xander is often more worried about ordinary teenage consequences than impossible events.
open_threads: Where the impossible wooded path leads.
